record.question: We obeyed the order the captain gave us.
record.explanation: Answer B: Adjective clause. “The captain gave us” modifies “order”; adjective clause. Independent check: “The captain gave us” is a relative clause with the relativized object “that” omitted, modifying “order.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/relative-clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Question 28 to 35): Identify the kind of the subordinate clause in the given sentences.
record.questionMarkup: We obeyed the order <u>the captain gave us</u>.
